description: Email address check without sending mail: syntax, MX/null-MX, disposable (214k-domain list), role account, free provider, typo suggestion, SPF/DMARC grade, deliverability score. Use before sending to, storing or trusting an email address (sign-up checks, list cleaning, lead qualification). Does not send mail, so it cannot prove the mailbox exists. Returns deliverable (likely, risky, undeliverable), score 0-100, valid, disposable, role, freeProvider, provider, suggestion (typo fix, e.g. gmial.com to gmail.com), normalized and flags[]. For many addresses use email_batch. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls, no wallet needed. Larger or cheaper variants, listed when the server URL ends in ?tools=all: email_batch (up to 10 addresses per call, $0.015).
name: email

smtp.description: Always false: no mail is sent

deliverable.description: Verdict: likely, risky, undeliverable or unknown

error.description: Batch only: set when this address could not be checked

normalized.description: Lowercased, Gmail dots and +tags removed, for deduplication

role.description: Role account such as info@ or noreply@

suggestion.description: Likely intended address when the domain looks like a typo

valid.description: Syntax is right and the domain accepts mail

title: Email address check
